name: – Michael Gahler – § 18/4
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: ‘reiterates its calls for a coalition of willing EU Member States to explore how to set up a defensive European-led integrated air protection zone that could employ combat air patrols over uncontested areas of Ukraine, which would help to protect Ukrainian civilians from indiscriminate attacks on civilian infrastructure, offer proactive defence against Russian incursions into EU airspace, and shift the balance of power to help force Russia to the negotiation table;’
